claims.claim: Core Web Vitals are LCP, INP and CLS; good thresholds LCP <= 2.5 s, INP <= 200 ms, CLS <= 0.1 at the 75th percentile of field data per device class.
INP replaced FID as a Core Web Vital on 12 March 2024.
Latest Lighthouse is 13.5.0 (2026-09-18); performance weights TBT 30, LCP 25, CLS 25, FCP 10, SI 10; INP has weight 0 and is not measured in navigation mode.

support_review.basis: Currentness register CW-03 and config read

claims.claim: @lhci/cli 0.15.1 bundles Lighthouse 12.6.1; the engine assertion set produced the same results and no auditRan failures when lhci assert was run against real reports from Lighthouse 12.6.1 and 13.5.0.

support_review.basis: npm registry record (@lhci/cli 0.15.1, published 2025-06-25, depends on lighthouse 12.6.1) and local lhci assert runs

claims.claim: Lighthouse default mobile throttling is 150 ms RTT, 1.6 Mbps down, 750 Kbps up, 4x CPU; 1.6 Mbps / 300 ms is WebPageTest's 3G preset, used here only as a labelled stress profile.
Lighthouse mobile emulation is 'moto g power (2022)' at 412x823, DPR 1.75.

support_review.basis: Source file and observed report environment

claims.claim: Kenya median mobile (Ookla, quarter to June 2026) is about 45 Mbps down and 28 ms latency; the Uganda mobile median is not published and is NOT_ASSESSED. SUPERSEDED in part 2026-09-25 by PERF-010 and PERF-011 (performance-currentness-2026-09-25.json): the 28 ms latency and the quarter-to-June-2026 month are unverified.
The web-vitals attribution build exposes LCP sub-parts, INP phases and CLS largest-shift targets; onFID no longer exists.
